authority.artifact_authority: Exact pinned package versions and the downloaded wheel SHA-256, plus raw metadata JSON SHA-256. No resolver-selected or unbounded package artifacts provide authority.
authority.closure: All base Requires-Dist and source-requested pytest-xdist[psutil] extra are checked. Optional extras not requested are retained as inactive evidence.
authority.dependency_requirements: Complete PyPI Requires-Dist and Requires-Python retained, checked against selected wheel METADATA. Catalog package_requirements are exact copies of PyPI Requires-Dist.
authority.metadata: PyPI HTTPS version JSON independently fetched with inherited proxy and verified TLS; wheel bytes independently downloaded and SHA-256 checked against the exact PyPI artifact digest.
authority.platform: CPython Linux x86_64. Legacy wheel selections are pure Python; modern wheel selections use supported CPython 3.12 and Linux x86_64 tags of the qualification executor. Empty platform_release/platform_version are explicit generic Linux values.
authority.scope: Finite supported generic profiles; this catalog does not claim support for every Python project. No target code or target tests executed for catalog construction.
authority.wheel_requirements_equivalence: Canonical distribution names, extras and PEP 440 specifiers; marker expressions compared in disjunctive normal form. Parenthesis-only and distribution underscore/hyphen differences do not change marker meaning.

extension.reason: Conservative source metadata includes unbounded ruff in requirements/testing.txt; the original 38-package receipt omitted this generic test tool. Add the exact generic compatible pin before any prospective target is selected.

generic_extensions.stage: catalog construction before prospective target inspection or execution
